title: DeepSeek TVP: Thinking with Visual Primitives
summary: A vision-language framework that interleaves spatial coordinates and bounding boxes as discrete tokens within a model's Chain-of-Thought reasoning. It bridges the 'Reference Gap' in multimodal models, enabling precise spatial grounding and long-form reasoning for complex visual tasks.
research_notes: Introduces Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) to achieve a 7056x vision compression ratio, reducing visual KV cache footprint to approximately 90 tokens per image.

evolution.summary: The TVP framework was briefly released in early 2026 before the official repository and paper were pulled for further refinement. Its core technology was subsequently integrated into the DeepSeek-V4 foundation models, where it currently powers high-precision spatial reasoning features.
